name: PathologyCatalogueMyCore
title: Malaysian Pathology Catalogue

description: The Malaysian Pathology Catalogue: the LOINC codes used by Malaysian pathology services, plus Malaysian interim codes for tests awaiting a permanent LOINC assignment. LOINC codes are enumerated by reference; no LOINC content is redistributed or modified.
